name: Money and payments
note: Income support and one-off payments from the Australian Government while you study.

name: Study costs and HELP
note: How uni fees are covered, and what you repay later.

name: Tax
note: The tax rules most students run into once they start working.

name: TAFE and apprenticeships
note: Fee-free TAFE, apprentice payments and travel help, tool allowances and TAFE scholarships and support.

name: Scholarships and bursaries
note: Scholarships, bursaries, awards and prizes from universities, TAFEs, foundations and student unions.

name: Hardship, loans and campus services
note: Emergency grants, short-term loans, food pantries, counselling, legal advice and other free services from your uni and student union.

name: Getting around
note: Cheaper fares between home and campus, and student fares for flights and coaches.

name: Bills and living costs
note: Energy, water and gas concessions and vehicle registration discounts, mostly with a concession card.

name: Health, fitness and concession cards
note: Concession cards, free and cheaper health services, gyms and the rebates a Health Care Card unlocks.

name: Software and study tools
note: Free or cheap software for students, from CAD and code to notes and design.

name: Laptops and devices
note: Education pricing on computers and tablets.

name: Entertainment and culture
note: Student plans for music and video, plus student prices at cinemas, galleries, theatres and museums.

name: Careers and memberships
note: Free and discounted student memberships of professional bodies, unions and networks that help you land work.
